clue.text: Choice of cipher proposed in power politics?

definitions.text: Choice of cipher proposed in power politics?

parts.words: Choice of cipher proposed in power politics?

explanation.surface: A question about how codes are chosen in international power games.
explanation.walkthrough: The ZERO OPTION was the 1980s proposal that both superpowers scrap all their intermediate-range nuclear missiles in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: An arms negotiation offer to cut weapons to none is a disarmament proposal known by this name.
